attchmntText: Saraswati Saree Depot Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Saraswati Saree Depot Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board reviewed the results along with the Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors PPC& Co. The company reported a profit before tax of 95.05 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 139.57 million for the same period in 2025. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the profit before tax was 25.84 million, versus 311.96 million in the prior year. Revenue from operations stood at 1433.87 million for the quarter and 2909.77 million for the half year. The statutory auditors expressed an unmodified conclusion on the financial statements. The results are subject to shareholder approval at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.
